items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. The interviewee (Warren Smith) does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe beyond the interview setting.

ctx.x: Warren was interviewed in Utica, NY on March 17, 2018 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have with me, in Utica, New York at the Other Side, Warren Smith. And I’m going to start out with an understatement. Warren Smith has done a few diverse things in his career. Is that a fairly true statement?
That’s true. I like to keep it a round robin you know.
